RECORD SUMMARY -- U.S. Food and Drug Administration public record 50138

Record type: FDA device recall record
Company named in the record: Philips
Product named in the record: NeuViz Dual Multi-Slice Computed Tomography (CT) Scanner System (software). Whole body x-ray computed tomography scanner which features a co

Declared fields
- Record identifier: 50138
- Decision / event date: 2008-04-10
- Applicant / firm as recorded: Philips
- Device or product as recorded: NeuViz Dual Multi-Slice Computed Tomography (CT) Scanner System (software). Whole body x-ray computed tomography scanner which features a co
- Advisory committee: not stated
- Decision description: not stated
- Country of applicant: not stated
- Product code: JAA
- Device class: Z-0001-2009

Additional notes recorded with this entry
- Reason or context as recorded: An issue associated with the "Timed Scan" application was found.  The system does not wait for the programmed time interval and starts the x-ray after selection of the scan button when certain criteria is met.
- Distribution as recorded: Nationwide Distribution --- USA including states of CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, NC, TN and TX.

This summary reproduces fields declared by the source record and adds no new
facts. Any interpretation of these fields is the reader's own.
